searchText: Wouldn't the DHTs remain separate anyhow due to the incompatiblities in wire protocol (discv5 vs discv5.1)? Unless there is a client that supports both protocols with the same routing table. I dont think any client is running v5.1 for spadina at least as far as I know Not yet I guess, but I understood that was the plan eventually. I must be misinformed. Afaik Spadina is only planned to be run for a few days, which might be too short a time to test out v5.1 . OK, fair enough. Just wanted it to be clear 🙂
